info.title: camw - constraint-aware mixed watermarking (authenticated payload
info.description: Command-line tool for CAMW (Constraint-Aware Mixed Watermarking): seal an authenticated watermark into a document and recover/verify it. Installs the `camw` command.

commands.name: PAYLOAD
commands.description:
--secret <s>    Master secret; the whole key hierarchy is derived from it.
--token <hex>   24-hex-char (12-byte) release token; random if omitted (seal).
--version <n>   Dataset version, 0-65535 (seal).
--purpose <n>   Purpose code, 0-65535 (seal).
--context <c>   Context string (e.g. schema id) authenticated into the tag (both).

commands.name: recover
commands.description: Decode and cryptographically verify the token (HKDF + HMAC + Reed-Solomon).

options.name: --secret
options.description: Master secret; the whole key hierarchy is derived from it.

options.name: --context
options.description: Context string (e.g. schema id) authenticated into the tag (both).
